title: Agent Skill frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a SKILL.md file (Agent Skills open standard).

name.description: Lowercase, hyphen-separated skill identifier; must match the directory name.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it. Stays in context, so keep it specific and trigger-rich.

allowed-tools.description: Pre-approved tools. The portable spec defines a space-separated string; Claude Code also accepts a YAML list. Both are valid here — prefer the string form for skills meant to run outside Claude Code.
